title: SDS-PAGE Gel Electrophoresis
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7hnhj5e
materials: Combine all reagents except the TEMED for the 15% separating gel (10ml)
Combine all reagents except the TEMED for the 5% stacking gel.

steps.title: Prepare Water Bath
steps.instruction: Place water in a 600 mL beaker and leave on a hot plate to boil (approximately 15 minutes or more).

steps.title: Cast Separating Gel
steps.instruction: Mix the separating gel solution using a Pasteur pipette and transfer it between the glass plates in the casting chamber to approximately 3/4 inch below the short plate.

steps.title: Level and Polymerize Separating Gel
steps.instruction: Add a small layer of absolute ethyl alcohol on top of the gel prior to polymerization to straighten the level and remove air bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Allow the gel to polymerize.
Remove the ethyl alcohol by absorption with Kimwipes or filter paper.

steps.title: Cast Stacking Gel
steps.instruction: Dry ethanol at RT, then mix the stacking gel solution using a Pasteur pipette and transfer it between the glass plates in the casting chamber.

substeps.instruction: Insert the well forming comb into the opening between the glass plates.

steps.title: Polymerize and Remove Comb
steps.instruction: Allow both separating and stacking gels to polymerize (typically within six minutes).

substeps.instruction: Gently remove the comb once the stacking gel has polymerized to form the gel cassette.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Suspension
steps.instruction: Process the bacterial suspension through a series of centrifugation and resuspension steps.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge bacterial suspension at 4ºC for 3 minutes at 15000g.
Discard liquid and resuspend in 500µL Buffer G (0.5 M Glycerol, 1mM Na 2 HPO 4 ).
Repeat the centrifugation (4ºC, 3 minutes, 15000g) and resuspension in 500µL Buffer G.
Centrifuge again at 4ºC for 3 minutes at 15000g.
Combine with 500µL Buffer G to resuspend.
Add 100µL lysis buffer to every microcentrifuge tube and mix by gently inverting.
Centrifuge at 15000g for 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Samples and Markers
steps.instruction: Prepare the protein samples and molecular weight (MW) markers for loading.

substeps.instruction: Mix 15µL of supernatant with 5µL 4x Laemmli sample buffer.
Mix 500µL of precipitation with 125µL 4x Laemmli sample buffer.
Aliquot 10 mL of MW marker (already in Laemmli sample buffer) into separate tubes.

steps.title: Denature Proteins
steps.instruction: Boil the samples for 10 minutes to fully denature the proteins, then leave at room temperature until ready to load.

steps.title: Assemble Electrophoresis Apparatus
steps.instruction: Set up the gel cassette within the electrode assembly and clamping frame.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gel cassette from the casting stand and place it in the electrode assembly with the short plate on the inside.
Slide the electrode assembly into the clamping frame and press down while clamping to secure and minimize leakage.

steps.title: Clean and Load Wells
steps.instruction: Fill and clean the wells before loading the samples.

substeps.instruction: Pour 1X electrophoresis buffer into the opening of the casting frame between the gel cassettes until wells are filled.
Use a gel loading tip to pipette buffer into each well to ensure cleanliness.
Slowly pipette 20µL of denatured sample or MW marker into each well.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Execute the electrophoresis run using the power supply.

substeps.instruction: Lower the clamping frame into the electrophoresis tank and fill the region outside the frame with 1X electrophoresis buffer.
Cover the tank with the lid, aligning the electrodes (black or red) appropriately.
Connect the tank to the power supply.
Run at 80V until the dye front reaches the bottom of the 5.0% Stacking Gel (3.0 mL).
Change the voltage to 120V (this can take around 2 hours).

steps.title: Complete Run and Disassemble
steps.instruction: Turn off the power supply and disassemble the apparatus once electrophoresis is complete.

steps.title: Stain Proteins
steps.instruction: Select staining method based on protein concentration.

substeps.instruction: Use Coomassie blue staining if the protein of interest is approximately 0.2 μg or more.
Use silver staining for higher sensitivity if protein levels are as low as 5 ng.
